note.question: Can a supplier credibly reveal private yield quality through costless nonbinding communication when the buyer also has private market information and controls the order response?
note.overview: The paper explicitly defines Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium for a cheap-talk game and distinguishes truth-revealing from babbling equilibria, then applies the NITS refinement.
